material.description: Unincinerated activated sludge; biological plant receives85%industrial and15%municipal wastewater; DAF and centrifugation. Fractions describe wastewater origins, not dry-solid blend.

input_policy: exact int/Fraction/finite Decimal; finite float means shortest decimal readout; no string or bool coercion; explicit K/degC
heat_semantics: J/kg water removed; total desorption heat already includes vaporization contribution under source dynamic measurement method. Not an extra heat source for a liquid/vapor energy host.
activity_semantics: Dynamic-method derived activity; relative chemical shift uses its own standard state. No absolute reference, equilibrium vapor pressure or kinetic driving force is admitted.
bounds_semantics: Conditional raster-footprint and affine-axis digitization bounds, with outward logarithm numerical bounds propagated separately; no experimental confidence interval.
